name: Cable Single Arm Bayesian Curl
cardText:
Cable Single Arm Bayesian Curl
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
2
Face away from the cable machine.
3
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Cable Single Arm Hammer Curl
cardText:
Cable Single Arm Hammer Curl
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
2
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
3
Use a neutral grip thumb facing up pinky-facing down). Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Cable Pull In
cardText:
Cable Pull In
Novice
1
Use a handle attachment set all the way to the top of the cable crossover machine.
2
Walk a few steps away from the cable machine. Face your body sideways.
3
Face your palm up toward the ceiling. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage.

name: Cable Twisting Curl
cardText:
Cable Twisting Curl
Advanced
1
Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
2
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
3
Start with a neutral grip. Flex at the elbow. While flexing twist your palm. When you hit the top of the movement your palm should be facing upward.

name: Cable Single Arm Reverse Curl
cardText:
Cable Single Arm Reverse Curl
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
2
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
3
Face your palm downwards. Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Cable Seated Bilateral High Curl
cardText:
Cable Seated Bilateral High Curl
Novice
1
Sit between high cables with arms extended outward and palms facing upward.
2
Curl both handles toward your head while keeping your upper arms stationary.
3
Squeeze your biceps, then slowly straighten your elbows.

name: Cable Seated Alternating High Curl
cardText:
Cable Seated Alternating High Curl
Novice
1
Sit between high cables with your arms extended outward and palms upward.
2
Curl one handle toward your head while keeping your upper arm stationary.
3
Slowly extend your elbow, then repeat with the opposite arm.

name: Cable Standing Bilateral Pull In
cardText:
Cable Standing Bilateral Pull In
Beginner
1
Stand between high cables, holding the handles in each hand.
2
Pull both elbows downward and inward toward your sides.
3
Squeeze your lats, then slowly extend your arms outward.

name: Cable Kneeling Alternating Pull In
cardText:
Cable Kneeling Alternating Pull In
Novice
1
Kneel in between high cables, holding the handles.
2
Face forward with palms facing upward.
3
Pull your elbow in toward your rib cage, extend your elbow, then pull with the other arm.

name: Cable Kneeling Bilateral Pull In
cardText:
Cable Kneeling Bilateral Pull In
Novice
1
Use a handle attachment set all the way to the top of the cable crossover machine.
2
Kneel in the middle of the cable crossover.
3
Face your palm up toward the ceiling. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage.

name: Cable Bilateral High Cable Curl
cardText:
Cable Bilateral High Cable Curl
Novice
1
Stand between high cables with arms extended outward and palms facing upward.
2
Curl both handles toward your head while keeping your upper arms stationary.
3
Squeeze your biceps, then slowly straighten your elbows.

name: Cable Bilateral Cross Cable Curl
cardText:
Cable Bilateral Cross Cable Curl
Beginner
1
Stand between low cables
2
Curl one side by bringing your lower arm across your body. Make sure to keep your upper arm stationary.
3
Squeeze your biceps, then slowly extend your elbows.

name: Cable Pull Around
cardText:
Cable Pull Around
Novice
1
Place cable pin all the way at the top or nearly at the top of the cable stack.
2
Face sideways and take a half kneeling position.
3
Grab the handle and reach across the body, begin the pull.
4
As you pull, imagine you are trying to put your elbow into your pocket.

name: Cable Standing Single Arm Cross Rear Delt Row
cardText:
Cable Standing Single Arm Cross Rear Delt Row
Beginner
1
Stand sideways to cable and hold handle across your body at opposite side.
2
Pull handle outward and back, leading with elbow and keeping arm slightly bent.
3
Squeeze rear delt at the end, then return slowly with control.

name: Cable High Single Arm Rolling Curl
cardText:
Cable High Single Arm Rolling Curl
Novice
1
Set cable at about elbow level. Stand facing away from the cables and grab handle attachment.
2
Take an underhand grip, flex your elbows, as you curl hinge forward.
3
As you extend your elbow, also extend your hips until you are back in a standing position.

name: Cable High Single Arm Reverse Rolling Curl
cardText:
Cable High Single Arm Reverse Rolling Curl
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set at elbow level.
2
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
3
Face your palm downwards, as you curl hinge forward.
4
As you extend your elbow, also extend your hips until you are back in a standing position.

name: Cable High Single Arm Reverse Bayesian Curl
cardText:
Cable High Single Arm Reverse Bayesian Curl
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set at elbow level.
2
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
3
Face your palm downwards, and curl.

name: Cable High Single Arm Hammer Rolling Curl
cardText:
Cable High Single Arm Hammer Rolling Curl
Novice
1
Set cable at about elbow level. Stand facing away from the cables and grab handle attachment.
2
Take a neutral grip, flex your elbows, as you curl hinge forward.
3
As you extend your elbow, also extend your hips until you are back in a standing position.

name: Cable High Single Arm Hammer Bayesian Curl
cardText:
Cable High Single Arm Hammer Bayesian Curl
Novice
1
Stand facing away from high cable, hold handle with palm facing inward.
2
Step forward to create tension and let arm extend fully behind you.
3
Curl handle toward shoulder, keeping palm neutral, then lower slowly.

name: Cable High Bayesian Curl
cardText:
Cable High Bayesian Curl
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set to about elbow height.
2
Face away from the cable machine.
3
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.
